references.text: Continuation of the instructions regarding the right thigh as a gift to the priest, clarifying which of Aaron's sons are to receive this portion.
Aaron and his sons perform the wave offering with the breast and the right thigh as part of the peace offering, as commanded.
Moses explains that the waved breast and the lifted thigh are to be eaten by the priests and their families in a clean place.
The priest is to wave the Nazirite's offering, including the boiled shoulder, as a holy gift to the priest.
The meat from the peace offering belongs to the priest, just like the waved breast and the right thigh.
Describes the priests' rightful share of the sacrificial animals, including the shoulder, which belongs to them from the people.
The basis for the peace offering is established at the consecration of Aaron and his sons, where the breast and the thigh are set apart for the priest.
